mutants.id: M1 ranking becomes FILTERING — the one thing this lane forbids
mutants.original:
tagged = ["[importer] " + snippet if _snippet_file(snippet) in importer_set
              else unknown + snippet
              for ident in identifiers
              for snippet in _find_function_callers(repo, ident, rel, importers)]
mutants.mutated:
tagged = ["[importer] " + snippet
              for ident in identifiers
              for snippet in _find_function_callers(repo, ident, rel, importers)
              if _snippet_file(snippet) in importer_set]

mutants.id: M2 the sort moves AFTER the cap, so it ranks what already lost the importer
mutants.original:
tagged.sort(key=lambda snippet: 0 if snippet.startswith("[importer] ") else 1)
    callers = _dedupe(tagged)[:_CALLER_SNIPPETS]
mutants.mutated:
callers = _dedupe(tagged)[:_CALLER_SNIPPETS]
    callers.sort(key=lambda snippet: 0 if snippet.startswith("[importer] ") else 1)
mutants.case: outer sort: a LATER identifier's importer is not crowded out

mutants.id: M3 the two tag literals are swapped
mutants.original:
tagged = ["[importer] " + snippet if _snippet_file(snippet) in importer_set
              else unknown + snippet
mutants.mutated:
tagged = [unknown + snippet if _snippet_file(snippet) in importer_set
              else "[importer] " + snippet
mutants.case: ranking: a file that IMPORTS the subject is tagged [importer]

mutants.id: M4 _importers_of goes blind on Python, so nothing is ever an importer
mutants.case: ranking: the importer sorts ahead of every name-match

mutants.id: M5 the caller walk ignores `prefer`, so a late importer is never COLLECTED
mutants.case: late importer: it is COLLECTED despite sorting past the walk's own cap

mutants.id: M6 the reserve is removed, so importers can starve the name-match class
mutants.case: reserve: the name-match class SURVIVES a cap-filling importer group

mutants.id: M7 membership becomes a SUBSTRING test, promoting sub/util.py over util.py
mutants.mutated: tagged = ["[importer] " + snippet if any(i in snippet for i in importer_set)
mutants.case: membership is EXACT: a path CONTAINING an importer's path is not promoted

mutants.id: M8 tags vanish entirely when nothing imports the subject
mutants.mutated: unknown = ("[name-match] " if importers_complete else "[unranked] ") if importer_set else ""
mutants.case: zero importers: snippets are STILL tagged, all [name-match]

mutants.case: findings mode: IMPORTED BY carries the real importers

mutants.id: M10 the snippet path is cut at the FIRST colon, corrupting colon-bearing paths
mutants.case: a colon in the path: the importer is still tagged [importer]
